messages.content: I purchased the Raleigh flight and Hampton stay we reviewed. The client just moved Friday’s end time from 3:00 to noon. Can you see whether I can switch to an earlier flight that afternoon?
Yes. I’ll compare earlier RDU-MSP options against the ticket you purchased. How much remains in the project travel allowance, and will you have your luggage with you at the client site Friday?
There’s $125 left. I can check out before work and bring my suitcase to the client office in Cary.

The best available nonstop is Delta departing RDU at 2:45 p.m. and arriving MSP at 4:38 p.m. The current fare is $92 more than your ticket, so it stays within the remaining allowance. Your Main Cabin ticket has no change fee, but the $92 fare difference would be charged when the exchange is completed.
Is there anything earlier, and what happens if the fare changes again after I switch?

There is a 1:10 p.m. nonstop, but it is $168 more and would exceed the allowance. For the 2:45 flight, the new ticket remains nonrefundable. A later voluntary change would be repriced at that time; canceling before departure would generally return the eligible ticket value as a Delta eCredit rather than cash. The quoted $92 difference is not locked until the exchange is submitted.
Check the timing from the client office. I don’t want to modify anything unless leaving after noon is realistic.

From Cary, a rideshare to RDU is typically about 20 to 30 minutes, with additional time possible in Friday traffic. Leaving the client office at 12:15 p.m. gives an estimated airport arrival around 12:45, about two hours before departure. Even with a 20-minute delay, you would still arrive roughly 1 hour 40 minutes ahead.
And checking out before the meeting won’t create a problem with the hotel?

No. The Hampton checkout is 11:00 a.m., so checking out before work and taking your suitcase is straightforward. The 2:45 p.m. flight is feasible if the session ends at noon and you leave the Cary office by about 12:30. The projected trip increase is $92, leaving $33 in the allowance. I have not modified the ticket.
